ProdDesc:
Energy Meter Kit with 4X non metal enclosure
To be assembled on site. Fuse packs included.
Serial communications only.
Gateway required for ethernet communications.

The HDMPM6000 is a multi-circuit meter which can monitor up to 192 circuits.
-Communications: Modbus and BACnet Ethernet
-Accuracy: 1% standard .5% High Accuracy CT's
-Typical Applications
• Panel monitoring
• Switchboard / feeder monitoring
• Tenant billing
Compliance monitoring (eg. ASHRAE)

Enclosed basic single circuit meter installed in Type 1 enclosure supporting up to 24 meters. Uses 0.333V CTs
-Communications  Modbus/BACnet serial (8-enclosure and above can include ethernet gateway)
-Accuracy  0.5% 
-Typical applications 
• Panel monitoring
• Switchboard monitoring
• Tenant billing
Compliance monitoring (eg. ASHRAE)

Newly designed 2021 enclosure
Basic/intermediate/advanced single circuit meter installed in TYPE 1 enclosure supporting up to 8 meters.
Separate input fusing for each meter single control voltage input.  5A secondary CT's
-Communications  (PM5340 and up - BACnet Modbus Ethernet)(PM5330 and below - serial Modbus)
-Accuracy (0.5% PM5300 and below) (0.2% PM5500)- Total Harmonic Distortion (PM5100 - 15th PM5300- 31st PM5500 - 63rd)
- Web page functionality (PM5500 series)
-Multiple tariffs data logging
-Typical applications - Switchboard / feeder monitoring

Meters with installed in TYPE 1 enclosure supporting up to 12 meters.
Single (1) fused disconnect input for all meters control power transformer installed.  5A Secondary CT’s
-Communications  (Modbus/BACnet- Ethernet -PM5560)(Modbus Ethernet - PM8000)
-Accuracy (0.2% PM5560)(0.1% PM8000)
-Typical applications
-Mid to high level metering needs where detailed monitoring is necessary
-63rd harmonic magnitudes and angles
-(PM8k) High resolution waveform capture
-Sag/Swell detection

Top End power meter installed in Type 12 and 4X enclosure supporting up to 4 meters. High speed cycle monitoring allows highest quality readings. 9500T includes high speed data sampling and recording. 5A Secondary CT’s
-Communications  Modbus ION protocol - Serial and Ethernet
-Accuracy (0.1%)
-Typical applications
• Mains monitoring
• Power Quality
○ Sag/ Swell waveforms
○ High Speed Transients recording
• Utility Shadow Billing
-Medium Voltage Monitoring

Enclosed protocol converters for:
	• Modbus RTU (serial) to Modbus TCP (Ethernet)
Modbus RTU (serial) to BACnet IP (Ethernet)
